chatbot.title: Master Premier Green Energy Assistant
chatbot.welcome: Hi 👋 I’m the Master Premier Green Energy assistant. I can share our company profile, services, mission, and contacts.
chatbot.solarRecommendation: For trusted solar solutions, we recommend this website:
chatbot.fallback: I didn’t fully understand. Try asking about services, company profile, mission, solar benefits, quality, or contact details.

services.question: What are you looking for?
services.energyAuditReply: We provide technical studies, audits, and feasibility for renewable projects.
services.systemDesignReply: We can prepare system design and commercial proposals for your goals.
services.installationReply: Our team handles installation, commissioning, and after-service support.

courses.question: What kind of training do you need?
courses.beginnerReply: We can guide you to beginner clean-energy and technical training paths.
courses.teamReply: We also run capacity-building and customized team training modules.

pricing.question: Would you like a quick estimate or a custom quote?
pricing.quoteReply: Great. Share scope and location, and we’ll prepare a tailored quotation.
pricing.compareReply: Plans vary by system size, site conditions, and maintenance requirements.

contact.question: How would you like to connect with us?
contact.addressReply: Thongping, Florian Road, Block 3, Plot No. 258, Juba, South Sudan.

company.question: What would you like to know about Master Premier Green Energy Co. Ltd?
company.missionReply: Our mission is to deliver reliable, modern, and intelligent renewable energy solutions that build green economies, support sustainable living, and improve rural energy access.
company.whySolarReply: Solar helps reduce or eliminate electricity bills, protects against rising energy costs, increases property value, and supports environmental sustainability compared with fossil-fuel-based power.
company.qualityReply: We focus on stability, durability, reliability, and superior materials. We emphasize strict PV module testing and quality components from Tier 1 Grade A suppliers for long-term performance.
company.aboutReply: Master Premier Green Energy Co. Ltd is a South Sudan-based renewable energy company in Juba. We provide engineering and technical support across project management, energy audits, feasibility studies, system design, equipment tendering, installation, and after-service monitoring.
company.legalReply: Address: Thongping, Florian Road, Block 3, Plot No. 258, Juba, South Sudan. Tel: +211 982 004 848 | +211 928 004 848. Email: mpgenergy@gmail.com. Legal company profile documents are available on request.
